display.purpose: Landing promises and the largest authored statements.

title.purpose: Route titles and prominent prompt-sheet content.

body.purpose: Base field values; supporting reading text uses a separate token.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display:inline-flex; min-height:46px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:9px; border:0; border-radius:5px; padding:0 18px; color:#fff; background:#215cff; font:700 .9rem ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; transition:background 150ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),transform 150ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-button-primary svg { width:17px; height:17px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; stroke-width:1.8; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background:#1549d8; transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline:0; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #f4f3ee,0 0 0 6px #215cff; }

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: The next local action on a focused panel surface.
components.html: <button class="ds-button-accent"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14" /></svg> ADD NOTE</button>
components.css: .ds-button-accent { display:inline-flex; min-height:46px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:9px; border:0; border-radius:5px; padding:0 18px; color:#162100; background:#d8ff36; font:700 .9rem ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; transition:background 150ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),transform 150ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-button-accent svg { width:17px; height:17px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-width:1.8; } .ds-button-accent:hover { background:#c3ea24; transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-accent:focus-visible { outline:0; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #181a19,0 0 0 6px #215cff; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A clean working field with a clear digital focus state.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:8px; color:#181a19; font:700 .8rem ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height:48px; border:1px solid #989b94; border-radius:5px; padding:0 12px; color:#181a19; background:#fff; font:400 1rem ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color:#215cff; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline:0; border-color:#215cff; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #f4f3ee,0 0 0 6px #215cff; }

components.name: Note Index
components.description: A compact orientation marker, never a decorative pill.
components.css: .ds-note-index { display:inline-flex; min-height:27px; align-items:center; border-radius:2px; padding:0 9px; color:#162100; background:#d8ff36; font:700 .72rem ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; }

components.name: Note Entry
components.description: One complete note and its local actions in a flat reading plane.
components.html:
Note 001

Decide the smallest useful release

Keep the useful edge clear and leave room for the next thought.

Updated Aug 11, 2026
components.css: .ds-note { display:grid; gap:18px; border:1px solid #989b94; border-radius:8px; padding:22px; color:#181a19; background:#fff; font-family:ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-note>div { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:18px; } .ds-note span { border-radius:2px; padding:6px 9px; color:#162100; background:#d8ff36; font-size:.72rem; font-weight:700; } .ds-note button { border:0; color:#575b57; background:transparent; font-weight:600; } .ds-note button:hover { color:#181a19; background:#e8eeff; } .ds-note button:focus-visible { outline:0; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #f4f3ee,0 0 0 6px #215cff; } .ds-note h2 { margin:0; font-size:1.16rem; letter-spacing:-.018em; } .ds-note p { max-width:68ch; margin:0; color:#575b57; line-height:1.7; } .ds-note time { color:#62665f; font-size:.72rem; font-weight:650; }

narrative.overview: Sourdough Starter looks like a working document prepared for use: paper, black cue rails, decisive controls, and compressed headings locate the task. This is a replaceable reference identity, not a brand requirement for seeded apps.
keyCharacteristics: Working paper and flat reading surfaces.

rules.name: The Two-Signal Rule
rules.body: Never swap action and cue roles for variety.

rules.name: The Native-Scroll Rule
rules.body: The document owns vertical scrolling; route content, lists, and cards remain overflow-visible.

rules.name: The One-Lift Rule
rules.body: Routine surfaces do not combine borders and ambient shadows.

dos: Do adapt semantic tokens before individual routes.
Do keep display type for orientation, not paragraphs.
donts: Don't decorate with lime or turn every surface into a floating card.
